metadata.title: BTS Delhi Food Awards 2024, Third Edition | Unsung Heroes of Delhi’s Street Food l Best of Delhi
metadata.description:
Step into the delightful world of the Delhi Street Food Awards 2024, now in its third edition, with our exclusive BTS video. This celebration of Delhi’s culinary artisans brought the foodie community together like never before. From meticulous planning to heartfelt interactions, this behind-the-scenes video captures the emotions, stories, and tireless efforts that made the event truly special.

Discover how every element came together—from curating the awards to shining a spotlight on the individuals who preserve and elevate Delhi's iconic flavors. This is more than just a celebration of food; it is a tribute to the legacy, resilience, and community spirit that form the backbone of Delhi’s vibrant culinary heritage.


About the host:
https://anubhavsapra.com/

Also follow us on
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks
